method_description: conjugation: the start rewritten through a GF(2^8) conjugate map, then staged gate-kernel pulls
found_utc_source: written by the conjugation job (its sidecar)

campaign.name: 2026-11-16-invsbox
campaign.launch: ../_runtime/bin/launch.sh <campaign archive>/run inv 43200 1800 1 (12 h; hub on CPUs 2-11, 10 workers; one conjugation job runner on each of CPUs 12-19; xsrun is the local systemd-run wrapper that pins the CPUs and caps memory)
campaign.seed_list: ../_runtime/run/seeds.list (the 91 pinned NIST inverse circuits, written by mkqueue.py)
campaign.hub_command: cd <checkout> && XS_INVSBOX=1 XS_INVSBOX_LINE=1 PYTHONPATH=<campaign archive>/shim python3 search/nonlinear/boolflux/hub/scheduler.py --dir <campaign archive>/run/hub --cpus 2-11 --hours 11.9333 --seed-list <campaign archive>/run/seeds.list --ops polish,pull,join,trb --seconds polish=90,pull=90,join=60,trb=30 --eps 0.25 --seed 1

runtime_layer.note: the inverse S-box support the run used, outside the repository at c0fb67d (BoolFlux was forward-only there): the shim rebinds, in-process, the S-box tables of boolflux/targets.py and independent/verify.py to their inverse tables and the NIST comparison set to the 91 inverse circuits; invconjpull.py runs ops/conjpull.py with inverse conjugates. Inverse support is being added to the BoolFlux code itself

code.checked: kernel source and ops/conjpull.py at run = c0fb67d (sha256)

reproducibility.text: one-off: a time-budgeted conjugation job (not bit-reproducible); not re-run. The exact command, seeds, code and the run's own logs for this circuit are here

command: XS_INVSBOX=1 PYTHONPATH=<campaign archive>/shim /usr/bin/python3 <campaign archive>/bin/invconjpull.py --in <checkout>/search/nonlinear/seeds/aes-invsbox/aes-invsbox-a35-ad3-g149-gd26-xx114-32.circ.txt --target <checkout>/search/nonlinear/seeds/aes-invsbox/aes-invsbox-a35-ad3-g149-gd26-xx114-32.circ.txt --seed 1025 --seconds 1800 --out <campaign archive>/run/conj/jobs/0025-r1-a35-ad3-g149-gd26-rank1_rank2_rank3 --conj rank:1,rank:2,rank:3 --schedule g:32:240,m:29:300,m:27:300,m:26:360,m:25:360,m:24:360 --repair-keep alt --screen-cache <campaign archive>/cache/conj3

paths.<checkout>: a checkout of this repository at commit c0fb67d (jobs started after 16:33 UTC record a3a10c3, whose search/ tree is the same)
paths.<campaign archive>: the campaign archive (not published); its shim/ and bin/ are published as ../_runtime/shim and ../_runtime/bin
paths.<home>: the home folder of the machine that ran the search (the kernel binary is built into <home>/.cache/boolflux)
